positioning.statement: One engineering team for mechanics, electronics, firmware and software. One contract, one point of accountability, one schedule.

points.title: Full stack in-house
points.body: Structure, actuation, PCBs, firmware, ROS 2 and AI are designed by the same team, so interfaces are solved before they become problems.

points.title: Measured outcomes
points.body: Every project starts with agreed targets — cycle time, precision, uptime, cost — and ends with a report against them.

points.title: Built for international work
points.body: Reviews in your time zone, code in your repository, documented hardware and door-to-door shipping.

servicesSection.title: Five engineering disciplines, delivered as one.

build.title: Every layer of the machine, engineered together.
build.lead: We design structure, actuation, electronics and software in parallel, with shared requirements and test plans.

structure.title: Structure
structure.body: Kinematics, FEA and design for manufacturing in machined, printed and sheet-metal parts.

actuation.title: Actuators
actuation.body: Motor and gearbox selection from a torque budget, with thermal models for continuous duty.

electronics.title: Electronics and PCB
electronics.body: Controller boards, power stages and sensor interfaces designed to IPC practices.

software.title: Software
software.body: Real-time firmware, ROS 2 architecture, perception and planning — with CI and tests.

process.title: A delivery process designed for hardware.

steps.b: Requirements, constraints and budget. A feasibility call within days.
Architecture, CAD, schematics and a costed bill of materials.
Functional hardware built and assembled in our workshop.
Test plans, endurance runs and safety and compliance pre-checks.
DFM, supplier sourcing, assembly documentation and pilot batches.
Remote diagnostics, firmware updates, spare parts and training.

about.title: An engineering company built to deliver hardware.
about.lead: Velkin brings mechanical, electrical, firmware and software engineering into one team so robots and automated systems move from idea to production without falling between suppliers.
about.missionBody: Make capable machines practical: reliable on the factory floor, simple to maintain and designed for the people who work alongside them.
about.facilitiesBody: Our workshop combines a 3D printing farm, CNC and laser cutting, an electronics bench, motor test rigs and a ROS 2 integration area where every prototype runs before it ships.

items.b: A dedicated engineer, weekly video reviews in your time zone and shared access to CAD, schematics and test results.
Door-to-door international shipping with export documentation, and on-site commissioning when required.
Remote diagnostics, over-the-air firmware updates, spare-parts kits and operator training.
Mutual NDA before the first technical conversation. Your designs and data remain yours.

privacy: What we collect: information you submit in our forms (name, job title, email, company, country, project details and files), basic technical logs needed for security and, only with your consent, anonymous aggregated analytics.

Purposes: answering your request and preparing proposals (pre-contractual steps), securing our services (legitimate interest), sending technical updates when you opt in, and improving the site (consent).
Retention: requests are kept for up to 24 months after the last interaction unless a contract requires longer. You may request deletion at any time.

Processors: hosting (Amazon Web Services, Vercel), CDN and security (Cloudflare), email delivery (Resend or Amazon SES). International transfers rely on Standard Contractual Clauses or equivalent safeguards.

Your rights: access, rectification, erasure, portability, objection and withdrawal of consent under GDPR, UK GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, LGPD, Colombian Law 1581 of 2012 and similar laws. We honour Global Privacy Control signals and do not sell or share personal information for cross-context behavioural advertising.
To exercise your rights, write to privacy@velkin.com. You may also lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.
terms: This website is provided by Velkin to inform about its services. Content may change without notice.
Case studies, specifications and figures are illustrative and do not constitute a binding offer. Proposals become binding only through a signed agreement.
Trademarks, designs and content on this site belong to Velkin or their respective owners and may not be reused without permission.
Files you upload remain your property; we use them only to evaluate your request and treat them as confidential.
To the extent permitted by law, the site is provided as is, without warranties.
